"b6e881a1-d03e-538b-b25f-9901e5967e80" :question/worked-solution "To find the general solution, we first separate the variables:

$$
\begin{aligned}y'+3 xy=0 \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+3 xy & =0 \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- 3 xy \\ \frac{1}{y}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- 3 x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate both sides with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{1}{y}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x & =\int (- 3 x)\,\text{d}x \\ \int \frac{1}{y}\,\text{d}y & =\int (- 3 x)\,\text{d}x \\ \ln|y| & =- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the general solution to the differential equation (in implicit form) is

$$
\ln|y|=- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C.
$$

We're required to write the solution in the form $y=y(x).$ By doing this, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\ln|y| & =- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C \\ |y| & =e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C} \\ |y| & =e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}}\cdot e^C \\ |y| & =K e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

where $K=e^C$ and $K>0.$

We can drop the absolute value bars by allowing $K$ to be either positive or negative. Therefore, the most general solution is

$$
y=K e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}}.
$$"] [:db/add "b6e881a1-d03e-538b-b25f-9901e5967e80" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "b6e881a1-d03e-538b-b25f-9901e5967e80" :question/answer-fields "a5b85e77-d6a2-593a-bb62-e1913ab6c0ec"] [:db/ensure "b6e881a1-d03e-538b-b25f-9901e5967e80" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068841 :knowledge-point/questions "b6e881a1-d03e-538b-b25f-9901e5967e80"] [:db/add "43728ce3-eb2b-5fc6-830f-805a4c28dae0" :answer/id #uuid "43728ce3-eb2b-5fc6-830f-805a4c28dae0"] [:db/add "43728ce3-eb2b-5fc6-830f-805a4c28dae0" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "43728ce3-eb2b-5fc6-830f-805a4c28dae0" :answer/value "y=K + e^{- 6 x^{2}}"] [:db/ensure "43728ce3-eb2b-5fc6-830f-805a4c28dae0" :answer/validate] [:db/add "314ddc43-96f1-59a8-8023-3bb59824bbd7" :answer/id #uuid "314ddc43-96f1-59a8-8023-3bb59824bbd7"] [:db/add "314ddc43-96f1-59a8-8023-3bb59824bbd7" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "314ddc43-96f1-59a8-8023-3bb59824bbd7" :answer/value "y=K e^{- 12 x}"] [:db/ensure "314ddc43-96f1-59a8-8023-3bb59824bbd7" :answer/validate] [:db/add "504849f0-11de-50f0-9d0f-349aab8ada59" :answer/id #uuid "504849f0-11de-50f0-9d0f-349aab8ada59"] [:db/add "504849f0-11de-50f0-9d0f-349aab8ada59" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "504849f0-11de-50f0-9d0f-349aab8ada59" :answer/value "y=K e^{6 x^{2}}"] [:db/ensure "504849f0-11de-50f0-9d0f-349aab8ada59" :answer/validate] [:db/add "3cd63917-a749-555a-bf9d-2fac66925065" :answer/id #uuid "3cd63917-a749-555a-bf9d-2fac66925065"] [:db/add "3cd63917-a749-555a-bf9d-2fac66925065" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "3cd63917-a749-555a-bf9d-2fac66925065" :answer/value "y=K e^{- 6 x^{2}}"] [:db/ensure "3cd63917-a749-555a-bf9d-2fac66925065" :answer/validate] [:db/add "1ee20c7f-6f9d-58e0-86be-a21e4c190232" :answer/id #uuid "1ee20c7f-6f9d-58e0-86be-a21e4c190232"] [:db/add "1ee20c7f-6f9d-58e0-86be-a21e4c190232" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "1ee20c7f-6f9d-58e0-86be-a21e4c190232" :answer/value "y=K - question.:question/problem: Find the general solution to the differential equation $y'+3 xy=0$ for $y\ne0.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
To find the general solution, we first separate the variables:

$$
\begin{aligned}y'+3 xy=0 \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+3 xy & =0 \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- 3 xy \\ \frac{1}{y}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- 3 x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate both sides with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{1}{y}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x & =\int (- 3 x)\,\text{d}x \\ \int \frac{1}{y}\,\text{d}y & =\int (- 3 x)\,\text{d}x \\ \ln|y| & =- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the general solution to the differential equation (in implicit form) is

$$
\ln|y|=- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C.
$$

We're required to write the solution in the form $y=y(x).$ By doing this, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\ln|y| & =- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C \\ |y| & =e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}+C} \\ |y| & =e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}}\cdot e^C \\ |y| & =K e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

where $K=e^C$ and $K>0.$

We can drop the absolute value bars by allowing $K$ to be either positive or negative. Therefore, the most general solution is

$$
y=K e^{- \frac{3 x^{2}}{2}}.
$$

question.:question/problem: Find the general solution to the differential equation $y'+xy=0$ for $y\ne0.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
To find the general solution, we first separate the variables:

$$
\begin{aligned}y'+xy=0 \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+xy & =0 \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- xy \\ \frac{1}{y}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate both sides with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{1}{y}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x & =\int (- x)\,\text{d}x \\ \int \frac{1}{y}\,\text{d}y & =\int (- x)\,\text{d}x \\ \ln|y| & =- \frac{x^{2}}{2}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the general solution to the differential equation (in implicit form) is

$$
\ln|y|=- \frac{x^{2}}{2}+C.
$$

We're required to write the solution in the form $y=y(x).$ By doing this, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\ln|y| & =- \frac{x^{2}}{2}+C \\ |y| & =e^{- \frac{x^{2}}{2}+C} \\ |y| & =e^{- \frac{x^{2}}{2}}\cdot e^C \\ |y| & =K e^{- \frac{x^{2}}{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

where $K=e^C$ and $K>0.$

We can drop the absolute value bars by allowing $K$ to be either positive or negative. Therefore, the most general solution is

$$
y=K e^{- \frac{x^{2}}{2}}.
$$
